body:
# Zet's Grace: Recraft Equipment
Preserving item data variant: [Zet's Grace: Repair Equipment](https://modrinth.com/datapack/zg-repair-eq)


## Description
Recipes for repairing equipment, added item data is lost. _(Added item data means components such as Enchantments, Dyed Color, and Item Name.)_


## Features
Adds recraft recipe for each equimpment with durability.


## Usage
any **Equipment** with durability
**+** its main **Ingredient**
**=** recrafted **Equipmemt**


## Details
Damaged equipment is replaced with brand new one.


## Limitations
Crafting doesn't support:
1. Usage of experience points.
2. Choosing how much durability can be repaired with single ingredient.
